messages:
Zoe: Quick recap from today's interview with Catalyst Health. Deliverables before publish: signed release, one short homepage pull quote, two social blurbs, and decision on customer participation in a webinar. Target launch: next Friday AM. Recording + notes: https://drive.google.com/catalyst-interview :sparkles:

Ethan: They called out a ~70% reduction in batch infra costs and faster p99. Asked not to name their previous vendor.

Riley (CS): Yep, technical lift came from caching + optimized kernels. I can draft a tech pull and a one-line demo blurb.

Gabe (Legal): Please use our standard release. If we keep numbers approximate ("~70%" or "about 3x cheaper"), that's safe; naming a competitor requires a data appendix and explicit customer attestation. I uploaded a redline: https://drive.google.com/open?id=catalyst-release-redline

Zoe: Cool. Ethan, can you draft two quote variants: cost-focused and product-velocity? Put them in the doc and I'll send for approval.

Ethan: Pasted in doc:
> "Redwood reduced our batching infrastructure costs by about 70% while improving p99 latency."
> "With Redwood's API and dedicated pools we shipped a new patient triage flow in under two weeks."

Riley (CS): Tech line suggestion: 
> "KV prefix caching and tailored kernels cut tail latency and reduced per-request compute costs."

Transcript Bot: Transcript processed: /files/4084567890-catalyst-transcript.txt

Zoe: Sending quote + release to the Catalyst contact now. I'll ask them to confirm which quote they'd prefer and to sign the release. Also ask if they'd join a 30-min webinar (10min customer story + demo).

Ethan: Sent to marketing@catalysthealth.com. Reply from their Head of Product: "Happy to sign. Prefer the first quote but please use 'about 70%'. We'll join the webinar for the customer segment. Attached signed release." Attached: https://drive.google.com/file/d/catalyst-signed-release.pdf

Gabe (Legal): Reviewing signed release now. If wording is "about 70%" and no vendor is named, that's cleared. I'll countersign the paperwork.

Gabe (Legal): Reviewed and countersigned. Approved quote: "Redwood reduced our batching infrastructure costs by about 70% while improving p99 latency." Cleared for blog, social, and webinar promo.

Zoe: Amazing. Marketing to finalize the homepage pull quote and two tweet-length lines by EOD tomorrow. Also need the customer's headshot + short bio for the webinar page. Ethan, Riley, please finalize assets.

Riley (CS): Uploaded tech slides and a short demo repo: /marketing/assets/catalyst-demo-repo.zip and slides: /marketing/assets/catalyst-webinar-slides-v1.pdf. I'll be presenting the demo and the customer will join for Q&A.

Ethan: Created quote graphic draft and two social lines in the assets folder.

HubSpotBot: HubSpot tag created: case-study/catalyst-health. Routing rule: owner = Healthcare SDRs. Signed release and transcript attached to new contacts with the tag.

Zoe: I'll schedule the launch post for Fri 9am and an internal preview for Sales on Thu 10am. @Gabe please note: any edits to the approved quote need fresh sign-off.

Gabe (Legal): Noted. Keep quote verbatim. Any change, re-approval required.

Ethan: Pushed final copy to the content calendar and scheduled the internal launch email.

Zoe: Closing once assets are live in Drive and RSVP page is up. Great work team! :tada:
